subject: Beginner shiny/shiny.io app question: how do I include a dataset with my shiny.io application?

messages.author: 21765e57069d24b8
messages.subject: Beginner shiny/shiny.io app question: how do I include a dataset with my shiny.io application?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am a beginner with R, Shiny, and Shiny.io so I apologize in advance for this really basic question. I went through the tutorial webinar today and afterwards I made an interactive bar chart using a dataset I had. This works fine on my local machine but I run into errors when I try to deploy it to shiny.io. I don't know how to include my dataset in the code.  I understand that I have to refer to the working directory on the shiny.io server but I don't know the path. I tried load("mydataset) but I received a message that said I had to be in the working directory. If I include read.RDS("mydata.rds") in the code, it can't find the object(mydata). I've also gotten error messages that I can't change the working directory.

I found this page but I'm not sure what the entire folder path is called: https://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/lesson5/

I am also not sure where I write this code. Should it be outside the ui and server code?

Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Beginner shiny/shiny.io app question: how do I include a dataset with my shiny.io application?
parts: The dataset should be copied to the app directory, or a subdirectory therein. Then express all paths as being relative to the app dir (Shiny always changes the working directory to the app dir, and you should basically never change the working dir from within your app code).

messages.subject: Re: Beginner shiny/shiny.io app question: how do I include a dataset with my shiny.io application?
parts:
I think I understood what I was doing wrong. I was trying to publish the app from the R script that I originally wrote the app in. I opened up a new file from the file menu "Shiny Web App" and put my code into this file. Now my app is deployed!

Thanks.
